The '''Kishh'tih airspeeder''' was a model of civilian [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Bakur RepulsorCorp]]. At six meters long, it seated four people, had a cargo capacity of 100 kilograms, could reach altitudes of up to 100 meters and could achieve speeds as fast as 360 kilometers an hour.

==History==
The Kishh'tih was a small, cheap, underpowered yet reliable airspeeder. It was designed mainly for joyriding in fair weather and had no weapons systems or armor plating. Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] stole this model of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] after having escaped from [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus|Nereus's]] private mountain retreat near [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].
